params.description: Only return events with a timestamp after this time. Default: now() - 24 hours.

params.name: before
params.description: Only return events with a timestamp before this time. Default: now() + 5 seconds.

params.description: The maximum number of results to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Allows to skip first offset rows. Will fail for value larger than 100000. Read about proper way of paginating: https://posthog.com/docs/api/queries#5-use-timestamp-based-pagination-instead-of-offset

params.description: Filter events by event property, person property, cohort, groups and more.

This endpoint allows you to list and filter events.
        It is effectively deprecated and is kept only for backwards compatibility.
        If you ever ask about it you will be advised to not use it...
        If you want to ad-hoc list or aggregate events, use the Query endpoint instead.
        If you want to export all events or many pages of events you should use our CDP/Batch Exports products instead.
